_howTo: Easiest: add events on the admin page (Admin → Events), with a picture. This file still works too: add one object per event to the events list. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; time is optional (24h, local). Upcoming and past are sorted automatically. artists uses the slugs from artists.json (blurfnes, rave-saint, nick). status can be on-sale, sold-out, free or announced. Remove nothing: past events move to the archive by themselves.
